editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where the line between life and death is completely blurred. You follow a story that feels like a fever dream, where strange things happen in dark corners and you never quite know who to trust. The vibe is creepy and mysterious, making you feel like something is always watching from the shadows. It is the kind of movie that keeps you guessing because the rules of the world keep changing, and the tension builds up slowly until you are on the edge of your seat wondering what will happen next.

What really works here is how the director uses bright colors and loud sounds to freak you out. The acting is solid, though some parts move a bit slow. If you love old-school scares and weird plots, you will really enjoy this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that the main character was caught in a loop between two different worlds. The big twist reveals that the people they thought were ghosts were actually the living ones. Everything wraps up when the lead character finally accepts their fate and crosses over completely. This closes the gap between the two worlds, leaving you with a bittersweet feeling as the screen fades to black.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old Italian horror and weird mysteries.
